title: Past perfect (I had done)
titleId: Sudah terjadi sebelum titik di masa lalu

cards.text: Past perfect: had + past participle. Dipakai saat bercerita tentang masa lalu, untuk kejadian yang terjadi lebih dulu sebelum titik cerita.

examples.en: When I arrived, the train had already left.
examples.id: Ketika saya tiba, keretanya sudah berangkat.

examples.en: I didn't watch the film with them. I'd seen it before.
examples.id: Saya tidak ikut menonton. Saya sudah pernah menontonnya.

cards.text: Present perfect = sampai sekarang. Past perfect = sampai titik tertentu di masa lalu.

examples.en: I'm not hungry. I've just eaten.
examples.id: Saya tidak lapar. Saya baru saja makan.

examples.en: I wasn't hungry. I'd just eaten.
examples.id: Waktu itu saya tidak lapar. Saya baru saja makan.

cards.text: Bandingkan past simple dengan past perfect:

examples.en: When I arrived, Tom had left.
examples.id: Tom sudah pergi sebelum saya datang.

questions.prompt: When we got to the cinema, the film ___ (already / start).
questions.why: Filmnya dimulai sebelum kami tiba (titik di masa lalu), jadi past perfect.

questions.prompt: I didn't recognise him. He ___ a lot.
questions.why: Perubahannya terjadi sebelum saat saya bertemu dia di masa lalu, jadi had changed.

questions.prompt: Susun kalimat (cerita masa lalu): "Rudi belum pernah naik pesawat sebelumnya."
questions.why: Pengalaman sampai titik di masa lalu memakai had never + past participle.

questions.prompt: We weren't hungry because we ___ just had lunch.
questions.why: Makan siangnya terjadi sebelum titik cerita di masa lalu, jadi had + past participle.

questions.prompt: When I got home, I found that someone has broken the window.
questions.answer: When I got home, I found that someone had broken the window.
questions.why: Ceritanya di masa lalu, dan jendela pecah sebelum saya tiba, jadi pakai past perfect.

questions.prompt: Nina wasn't at the party. She ___ (go) home early.
questions.why: Nina pergi sebelum titik cerita (pesta), jadi past perfect: had gone.

pairs: Was Tom there when you arrived?
Nobody had cleaned it for weeks.
I couldn't get into my flat.
She'd never given a speech before.
questions.why: Penjelasan di kanan menceritakan hal yang terjadi lebih dulu, jadi memakai past perfect.

questions.source: Ketika saya tiba, mereka sudah pergi.
questions.answer: When I arrived, they had already gone
accept: When I arrived, they had already left
When I arrived, they had gone
When I arrived, they had left
They had already gone when I arrived
They had already left when I arrived
They had gone when I arrived
They had left when I arrived
questions.why: Mereka pergi sebelum saya tiba, jadi past perfect: had gone atau had left.

questions.prompt: "Was Dina still at the office when you got there?" "Yes, but she ___ a few minutes later."
questions.why: Dina pulang setelah saya tiba (berurutan), jadi past simple.

questions.prompt: I knew the city well because I had lived there before.
questions.answer: I knew the city well because I had lived there before.
questions.why: Kalimat ini sudah benar: tinggal di sana terjadi sebelum titik cerita di masa lalu.
